было.подтема: общие советы Gemini 3 не подтверждены для image-моделей
было.title_en: Generic Gemini 3 advice unconfirmed for image models
было.content_en: Generic Gemini 3 advice (thinking_level, temperature, media_resolution, prompting best practices) is stated for Gemini 3 text and understanding models and is not confirmed for the image model; those guides never name an image-generation model.
было.applies_when_en: Advice found on a general Gemini 3 page (thinking_level, temperature, media_resolution, prompt best practices, batch) is about to be carried over to the image model.
было.not_applies_when_en: The image documentation gives its own direct advice, or the page is dedicated directly to image models.
caveats_en: General Gemini and Agent Platform pages are text-centric: the Gemini 3 guide treats images only as input (understanding, token cost, segmentation) and says only that gemini-3.1-pro-preview has no image output; the batch-inference page mentions image generation only as the 1K output limitation and in the model list; the generative AI beginner's guide describes one text-centric request pipeline (prompt, foundation model, optional customization and augmentation, citation check, safety filters, response) with image generation only as a quickstart link; the prompt file in the Genkit Go Nano Banana codelab targets the text model vertexai/gemini-2.5-flash; the Gemini Apps section on Gemini 3 models lists only text models and does not link chat-model or thinking-level choice to image quality or cost; this is an inference (models: other, unspecified).
Gemini 3 is described as the most intelligent model family to date, built on state-of-the-art reasoning; image models are not named there (models: other).

Image segmentation is not supported by Gemini 3 models; for built-in segmentation the recommendation is to keep using Gemini 2.5 Flash with thinking turned off (image understanding, not generation) (models: other).
gemini-3.1-pro-preview does not support image output (models: other).
The only content-generation use case on the batch-inference page is generating product descriptions, social media posts or other creative text in bulk (models: unspecified).
In the generative AI request pipeline, the last layer of checks that the prompt and response go through before being returned is the safety filters (models: unspecified).
canaries_en: Apply the Gemini 3 prompting best practices to my image prompt
Use the temperature the Gemini 3 guide recommends for this image generation
Set media_resolution for the image model as the Gemini 3 docs suggest

terms.значение_en: built-in reasoning before generation; image models have a reduced set of levels
